correctness.rationale: Weighted Prüfer partition function, exact path-containment contraction and root/nonroot distance-survival formulas yield all conditioned means for each n and admissible degree by coefficient extraction. A closed adjacent-degree difference plus a strictly positive rational induction proves decline from degree two; leaf deletion and uniform-edge subdivision yield a strict first increase using W_m >= (m-1)^2. Exceptional n=2,3 checked separately. Standalone exact enumeration through n=8 and larger rational tests passed; finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The Wiener index measures global pairwise separation while a specified degree is local. Their zero ordinary covariance hides a sharp nonmonotone conditional relationship with the unique maximizer degree two at every order n>=4; exact finite-size regression and component-wise plateau are structurally meaningful, not a marginal moment or arbitrary numerical slice.
